cases.name: torus_guard_minor_eff_zero
cases.note: Torus radius guard boundary (major 1.0, minor 1e-12; SmTorus::CreateCanonical rejects a radius <= SM_EFF_ZERO = 1e-12 with SM_ERR). The call is SM_BO_EXTRACT_SEPARATE, which SmApiBoolean rejects (SM_ERR_INVALID_INPUT) only after the operands are built, so the record is the constructor's accept or reject.
